source_text: Non cecidit verbum unum ex omnibus quae locutus est Dominus — fides promissionum. Omnia impleta.
pass_a_gloss: Not fell word one from all which spoke Lord — faith of-promises. All fulfilled.
pass_b_english: [[Not one word failed of all the Lord spoke >> Bible:Joshua 21:45]] — the promises’ faithfulness. All fulfilled.
